scope: Exploratory paired differences. Draws count as half for each side; paired seat differences are averaged within each seed before estimating SE. Sixteen seed clusters per row are small and selected fixtures are not a tournament. No tuning or universal balance claim.

rules: Win
Reduce the enemy hero to zero hearts.
Turn

Choose one draw: take 1 from your deck or the axiom deck. Energy grows by 1 and refills (max 10). Use up to 2 card activations: casts, attacks and manual Activate together. Used rule cards never come back. When your deck and the rule deck are both empty, each draw costs hearts: 1, then 2, then 3.
Attacks
Each ready creature may attack once. New creatures wait a turn unless Swift.
Combat
Both creatures deal damage equal to their attack. Damage stays.
Guard
If the enemy has Guard creatures, attack one of them first.
Hero hits
An attack on a hero removes hearts equal to its attack.
Costs
Creatures +1 energy. Activating uses the creature's attack.
Defeat
Defeated creatures go to the discard pile.
